content: **Seasonal Let's Do** 是一款模组，旨在实现 [Let's Do 模组](https://modrinth.com/mods?q=[Let%27s+Do]) 与流行季节系统（如 [Serene Seasons](https://modrinth.com/mod/serene-seasons)、[Fabric Seasons](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-seasons) 和 [Forge Seasons](https://modrinth.com/mod/forge-seasons)）之间的无缝兼容。 ## 许可证 感谢 Serene Seasons 兼容性数据包的原作者 [NobodyH3e](https://modrinth.com/user/NobodyH3re) 本模组遵循 [Apache-2.0 许可证](https://github.com/xhyrom/seasonal-letsdo/blob/ver/1.21/LICENSE)。
